svg.text: STAGE 512 · TOPIC 152 · P1017–P1018 🎉 · SVG 156 · 154th FAQ · 🎉 HISTORIC 515th BENCHMARK DIMENSION MILESTONE!
WebRTC/RTP RFC 6465 / RFC 6464 Audio-Level VAD Spoofing, Barge-In Hijack & CSRC Alignment Guard
⛔ Vulnerable RFC 6464 / 6465 Path (Silent Gag & CSRC Shift)
1. Spoofed V=1, level=0 (0 dBov) on 2-Byte Silent DTX Frames
ssrc-audio-level: 0x80 (V=1, 0 dBov) + Payload: 2B DTX Silence
• Header-only detector thinks client is shouting at full scale
• Permanently interrupts & gags AI Voice Agent TTS output
2. Unbounded / Misconfigured Barge-In Threshold (-80 dBov)
activeSpeakerFloorDbovThreshold = 80 (-80 dBov ambient hum)
• Air-conditioning hum or keyboard clicks trigger false barge-in
• Causes constant active-speaker camera & turn-taking thrashing
3. RFC 6465 CSRC Count Mismatch & Forbidden r-bit = 1
RTP CC=3 vs 5-Byte csrc-audio-level (or r-bit=1 violation)
• Desynchronizes CSRC[i] speaker ID from audio level index
• Corrupts multi-party AI diarization & compliance attribution
✅ Deterministic RFC 6464 / 6465 Guardrails (P1017 + P1018 🎉)
P1017 (1,026th Guardrail): Payload RMS Cross-Check & [25, 55] dBov
action: "cross_check_pcm_rms_and_clamp_barge_in_dbov_threshold"
• Verifies Opus frame size / PCM RMS energy before Barge-In interrupt
• clampedSpoofedHeaderOnlyBargeInTriggers = 0 (zero silent gag DoS)
• clampedActiveSpeakerFloorDbovThreshold in [25, 55] dBov
Policy: P1017-WEBRTC-RFC6464-SSRC-AUDIO-LEVEL-VAD-SPOOFING-AND-BARGE-IN-FLOOR-GUARD
P1018 🎉 (Historic 515th Dimension!): CSRC Alignment & r-bit=0 Lock
action: "enforce_cc_count_alignment_and_zero_rfc6465_reserved_v_bit"
• Enforces len(csrc-audio-level) === RTP CC & masks reserved r-bit = 0
• clampedMisalignedCsrcAudioLevelExtensions = 0 (zero speaker shift)
• clampedMaxCsrcAudioLevelContributors in [1, 15] (RFC 3550 4-bit CC)
Policy: P1018-WEBRTC-RFC6465-CSRC-AUDIO-LEVEL-COUNT-ALIGNMENT-AND-V-BIT-FORBIDDEN-GUARD
